messages:
alex: quick sync on the Acme pilot scope - customer wants concise, actionable Optimize recommendations: batching presets, KV-cache TTL guidance, two quant tiers, and eval-triggered alerts. propose 2-week pilot with strict canary and a rollback path.

sam: suggest we limit batching output to three knobs: max_batch_delay_ms, max_batch_size_hint, seq_len_cutoff. defaults must be conservative.

maria: quant tiers: 'latency' (q8) and 'cost' (q4-hybrid). will require vignettes baseline to validate. also recommend sampled nightly evals not full-run every night.

raj: Acme note: pilot runs on dedicated; they want clear list of critical vignettes that never run aggressive quant. will confirm.

ellen: CS: Acme provided 1.2k prompts and 18 must-pass vignettes. alerting thresholds: quality drift >5% or p99 latency +200ms.

nitesh: SRE: canary cap 30% traffic, fallback to compatible model variant on alerts, and per-tenant KV TTL must be adjustable.

alex: acceptance checklist (short): recommendations exporters per-route, eval pass for each quant (<=2% metric drop), p95 latency within target, alerts wired to console + ops channel.

sam: sample recommendation JSON in thread for devs. keep prod schema richer but MVP small.

maria: eval-alert types: quality-regress, latency-degrade, econ-signal. each alert includes diffs, top failing samples, suggested mitigations.

raj: commercial: if pilot shows >10% unit cost reduction, Acme will consider committed capacity.

ellen: CS will draft runbook including data retention (eval artifacts 30d, PII redaction) and rollback steps.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary job: canary-optimize-v1 at 3487720000.

alex: locking scope if no objections. open items: final knob names (sam), eval harness (maria), canary alert wiring (nitesh), vignettes/retention wording (raj/ellen).

sam: locking, will post knobs.

maria: will start eval harness.

(ends)
